title: VMLogin
description: This is a simple Minecraft auth plugin.
body:
# VmLogin

**A secure authentication plugin for Paper 1.21.1+ by Arc Creations.**

---

# Features

**🔐 Secure password registration and login system**

**🌍 IP binding — accounts locked to registered device**

**👁️ Blindness effect before authentication**

**🏠 Auth spawn system with coordinate support**

**🔑 Admin password reset command**

**📋 Login history tracking**

**⚠️ Failed attempt protection with temp ban**

---

![va](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7641cc1ddc7976b9f8cc8532cbbeec0cd0edb56_0.webp)

# Commands

**Player Commands:**
- `/register <password> <confirmPassword>` — Create your account
- `/login <password>` — Login to the server
- `/changepassword <old> <new>` — Change your password

**Admin Commands:**
- `/vmlogin spawn set <x> <y> <z>` — Set auth spawn location
- `/vmlogin reset <player> <password>` — Reset a player password
- `/vmlogin stats` — View server login statistics
- `/vmlogin history <player>` — View player login history

---

# Installation

**1.** Download the JAR file

**2.** Place it in your server's `plugins` folder

**3.** Restart your server

**4.** Configure `config.yml` to your liking

**5.** Set auth spawn using `/vmlogin spawn set <x> <y> <z>`

---

# Requirements

**Server:** Paper 1.21.1 or higher
**Java:** Java 21 or higher
